components.name: Hooks
components.introduction: React hooks for local state, synchronization, and loading Solution data.
components.guidance: Use controlled state for local interaction. Effects should synchronize with external systems, not duplicate derived state.

members.name: useForm(options)
members.description: Standard React Hook Form state, validation, errors, reset, and submitting state. Use zodResolver(schema) with Zod, Controller with shadcn Field components, and FormProvider/useFormContext for nested forms and Wizard.

members.name: useSubmit(path, options)
members.description: Returns an awaitable, duplicate-protected scoped write function accepting FormData. Options: method (POST by default, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), onSuccess(data), and onError(error). Cache refresh completes before onSuccess. In onError, call form.setError('root', { message }) so failure is visible and isSubmitSuccessful stays false. Unhandled failures reject. Append repeated values and binary files explicitly; React Hook Form owns submitting state.

members.name: useState(initial)
members.description: Returns the current state and a setter. Pass a value or an initializer function; updates can use the previous state.

members.name: useEffect(effect, dependencies)
members.description: Synchronizes with external systems after rendering. Return a cleanup function to release timers or subscriptions. Include every reactive value used by the effect in its dependencies.

members.name: useMemo(factory, dependencies)
members.description: Caches a calculated value until its dependencies change. Use it for expensive calculations, not required application state.

members.name: useRef(initial)
members.description: Returns a stable object with a mutable current property. Changing current does not trigger a render.

members.name: useApi(path)
members.description: Returns Solution data and an awaitable invalidator scoped to the full request path. The renderer handles initial loading, errors, and retry.

members.name: useConfirm()
members.description: Returns show(options), hide(), isOpen, and element; render element once in JSX. Options require title, actionLabel, and onAction: () => void | Promise<void>. Optional description, cancelLabel (default Cancel), and actionVariant: default | destructive (default default). Cancel receives initial focus; Escape cancels and backdrop clicks do not dismiss. Async actions show loading, prevent duplicate submissions, and close only after success. Failure keeps the dialog open for retry; scoped request errors are reported by the host, other errors appear inside the dialog. While pending, Cancel, Escape, show(), and hide() are ignored. Example: const confirmation = useConfirm(); confirmation.show({ title: 'Conferma variante A', cancelLabel: 'Annulla', actionLabel: 'Continua', onAction: async () => { await request('/api/variants', { method: 'POST', json: { variant: 'A' } }); } }); Render {confirmation.element} beside the trigger Button.

components.name: Icon
components.introduction: Loads and caches Lucide icons by kebab-case name without blocking the View or changing icon dimensions.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Lucide kebab-case icon name.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Icon size; inherits the parent default or falls back to md.

components.justification: Loads Lucide icons through the isolated runtime's icon capability.

components.name: Image
components.introduction: Coordinates failed image states and scoped attachment preview capabilities.

properties.name: src
properties.description: Scoped Solution image path, or an image data/blob URL.

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Accessible description of the photo.

components.justification: Coordinates failed image states and scoped attachment preview capabilities.

components.name: Link
components.justification: Coordinates scoped navigation, file capabilities, and async actions while preserving native anchor or button semantics.
components.introduction: Link for navigation, scoped file preview or download, and callback actions.
components.guidance: Use href for navigation, add preview or download for scoped files, or omit href for an onClick action. Actions render as buttons with async loading and duplicate-click protection.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Solution-relative or safe external HTTP(S) navigation destination, or scoped file path. Omit for callback-only actions.

properties.name: ...props
properties.description: Navigation forwards anchor props and ref; file and callback actions forward button props and ref.

properties.name: onClick
properties.description: Runs a callback; actions track async loading. preventDefault cancels navigation or file handling.

properties.name: preview
properties.description: Opens the attachment in a preview dialog using this filename.

properties.name: download
properties.description: Downloads a scoped Solution attachment with this filename instead of navigating. An empty string uses attachment.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables navigation or the action.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Link content

components.name: Menu
components.introduction: Groups side navigation and the selected section's content.

properties.name: children
properties.description: MenuSection elements defining navigation and content.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Spacing between navigation and content using the shared spacing scale.

properties.name: MenuSection.children
properties.description: MenuItem elements or nested MenuSubSection groups.

properties.name: MenuSection.isHeaderHidden
properties.description: Hides the section heading; visible by default.

properties.name: MenuSection.title
properties.description: Section heading displayed in the navigation.

properties.name: MenuItem.children
properties.description: Content mounted beside the navigation while this item is selected.

properties.name: MenuItem.icon
properties.description: Optional Lucide icon name displayed beside the label.

properties.name: MenuItem.label
properties.description: Navigation label; its lowercase, hyphenated form identifies the item's URL fragment.

properties.name: MenuSubSection.children
properties.description: MenuItem elements nested inside this collapsible group.

properties.name: MenuSubSection.icon
properties.description: Optional Lucide icon name displayed beside the group label.

properties.name: MenuSubSection.label
properties.description: Label displayed on the collapsible navigation group.

components.justification: Coordinates Solution side navigation, section selection, and persistent section content.

components.name: DataPagination
components.guidance: Renamed from Pagination. Existing Views that use page, pageSize, totalItems, and onPageChange must use DataPagination; Pagination now exposes native shadcn composition.
components.introduction: Navigates pages of table or gallery items without owning their data or selection.

properties.name: page
properties.description: Current page number, starting at 1.

properties.name: onPageChange
properties.description: Receives the selected page number.

properties.name: totalItems
properties.description: Total item count used to calculate pages, overriding totalPages.

properties.name: pageSize
properties.description: Number of items per page. Coerced to a positive integer; non-finite values fall back to the default.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible navigation label; defaults to Pagination.

components.justification: Calculates bounded page selection from item counts and notifies the data owner without inventing navigation URLs.

components.name: Progress
components.introduction: Displays progress with a built-in track, indicator, and fixed styling.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Custom text or JSX displayed on the left above the bar.

properties.name: showValue
properties.description: Shows the formatted current value.

properties.name: valueText
properties.description: Custom text or JSX displayed on the right instead of the percentage.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Required current value; null makes progress indeterminate.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum value.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Minimum value.

properties.name: locale
properties.description: Locale for number formatting.

properties.name: getAriaValueText
properties.description: Provides an accessible alternative to the numeric value.

components.justification: Provides a props-based progress API with fixed styling while preserving Base UI formatting and accessibility.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.introduction: Selects one string value from labeled options with internally owned radio composition.
components.guidance: Supply options instead of RadioGroupItem children. Labels, feedback, and keyboard navigation are internal. Box owns width and callers own validation.

properties.name: options
properties.description: String value, label, and optional disabled state per option.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Form submission name.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires a selection before form submission.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables all options, including keyboard focus and form submission.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled selected value.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled selected value.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Called with the next selected value and Base UI event details.

components.justification: Owns option and field composition while Base UI retains keyboard navigation and form behavior.

components.name: Select
components.introduction: An options-based select with single or multiple string values.
components.guidance: Supply options and optional label, description, and error. Trigger, popup, and option composition are internal. Use multiple with array values and repeated named form entries. Box owns width.

properties.name: options
properties.description: String value, label, and optional disabled state per option.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled selection; multiple controls array selection.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled selection.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Native selection changes with cancelable event details.

components.justification: Owns select composition and field presentation while retaining Base UI selection and form semantics.

components.name: Combobox
components.introduction: Searchable string options with internally owned input, popup, and multiple-selection chips.
components.guidance: Supply options and optional label, description, and error. Search matches labels; submitted values remain option values. Use multiple for array values. Loading and data fetching remain caller-owned.

properties.name: options
properties.description: String value, label, and optional disabled state per option.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled selection; multiple controls array selection.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled selection.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Native selection changes.

properties.name: inputValue
properties.description: Controlled search text.

properties.name: onInputValueChange
properties.description: Receives search text changes.

components.justification: Owns searchable option composition, chips, and field feedback while Base UI manages interaction and native values.

components.name: Slider
components.introduction: Edits scalar or range values with internally composed, labeled thumbs.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Includes the themed control's value under this form submission name.

properties.name: form
properties.description: ID of the form owning the native slider inputs.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Prevents interaction and excludes the field from submission.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Minimum value.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum value.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Step increment.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled value, with one value per thumb for arrays.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial value.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Receives the inferred numeric or array value and cancelable native event details.

properties.name: onValueCommitted
properties.description: Receives committed changes and noncancelable native event details.

properties.name: minStepsBetweenValues
properties.description: Minimum number of steps between thumbs in range mode; prevents thumbs from overlapping.

properties.name: largeStep
properties.description: Increment for Page Up/Down or Shift+Arrow.

properties.name: thumbAlignment
properties.description: Thumb alignment at the track boundaries.

components.justification: Owns thumb composition and accessible field feedback while Base UI manages values, keyboard editing, and form inputs.

components.name: Stack
components.introduction: Arranges View content using Tailwind spacing steps.
components.guidance: Accepts native div attributes and events. Configure layout through the supported layout props; parent containers control sizing.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Stack content.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Spacing between items.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Inner padding using the spacing scale.

properties.name: paddingInline
properties.description: Horizontal padding, overriding padding on the inline axis.

properties.name: paddingBlock
properties.description: Vertical padding, overriding padding on the block axis.

properties.name: background
properties.description: Optional muted surface background; omitted stacks remain transparent.

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Horizontal or vertical layout direction.

properties.name: justify
properties.description: Main-axis alignment.

properties.name: align
properties.description: Cross-axis alignment alias. Mirrors CSS align-items.

properties.name: wrap
properties.description: Flex wrap behavior.

properties.name: StackItem.children
properties.description: Content rendered inside the stack item.

properties.name: StackItem.crossAlignSelf
properties.description: Overrides this item's cross-axis alignment; omitted values inherit the parent alignment.

components.justification: Provides a flex layout composition with independently scrollable children; no Stack primitive exists in shadcn/ui or ReUI.

components.name: Wizard
components.introduction: Custom LongLink wizard with persistent Step panels, React Hook Form validation, and guarded asynchronous actions. Wrap the form in FormProvider and declare Step.fields. Next validates those field paths; a submit Button in the last Step invokes the form's handleSubmit. Set shouldFocusError: false so Wizard can reveal invalid hidden steps before focusing them.

properties.name: height
properties.description: Bounds a wizard, pinning progress above its scrollable panels.

properties.name: next
properties.type: (step: number) => { label: string; action: () => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean> } | undefined
properties.description: Runs intermediate work after validation. Returning false prevents advancement.

properties.name: onCancel
properties.description: Adds a Cancel action to wizard navigation.

properties.name: backVariant
properties.description: Wizard Back button appearance.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Step elements to render in the stepper.

properties.name: activeStep
properties.description: Zero-based active index. Wizard mode manages selection internally when omitted.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Layout direction of the stepper.

properties.name: onStepClick
properties.description: Receives wizard selection changes.

properties.name: Step.label
properties.description: Visible label identifying the step.

properties.name: Step.fields
properties.description: React Hook Form field paths to validate before leaving the step. Include shared fields in every step that requires them.

properties.name: Step.description
properties.description: Supporting text displayed below the step label.

properties.name: Step.children
properties.description: Persistent Wizard panel content.

components.justification: Keeps drafts mounted and coordinates explicit RHF step validation, invalid-step focus recovery, and guarded asynchronous advancement.

components.name: Switch
components.introduction: A boolean preference with an optional adjacent label and associated validation feedback.
components.guidance: Use checked, defaultChecked, onCheckedChange(checked, eventDetails), size, and disabled. Label and feedback composition are internal.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Controlled checked state.

properties.name: defaultChecked
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled checked state.

properties.name: onCheckedChange
properties.description: Native Base UI callback.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables interaction and excludes the control from submission.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native form field name.

components.justification: Owns labeled switch presentation while retaining native checked state and form participation.

components.name: Table
components.introduction: Displays semantic tables with fixed styling, optional text wrapping, and cell alignment.
components.guidance: Compose TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, and TableCaption. Use ReUI DataGrid for sorting, selection, and pagination.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Table parts with standard HTML attributes, events, and refs; styling overrides are excluded.

properties.name: wrap
properties.description: Wraps cell text instead of keeping it on one line.

properties.name: TableHead.align
properties.description: Header text alignment.

properties.name: TableCell.align
properties.description: Cell text alignment.

components.justification: Provides fixed table styling with explicit wrapping and logical alignment while preserving native table semantics.

components.name: Tabs
components.introduction: Switches between related content panels.
components.guidance: Compose Tabs with Tab children. Each Tab supplies a stable string value, a label, and its panel content. The first enabled Tab is selected when defaultValue is omitted.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Tab definitions containing labels and panel content.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled selection; defaults to the first enabled Tab value.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Receives the selected value without library event details.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled selection.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Tab list appearance.

properties.name: Tab.disabled
properties.description: Whether the tab is disabled.

properties.name: Tab.value
properties.description: Stable selection value associating the tab with its panel.

properties.name: Tab.label
properties.description: Visible tab label.

properties.name: Tab.children
properties.description: Panel content mounted when selected.

properties.name: Tab.keepMounted
properties.description: Keeps an inactive panel in the DOM.

components.justification: Owns tab and panel composition through Tabs and Tab while retaining native selection, keyboard behavior, and fixed styling.

components.name: Text
components.introduction: Adds optional line truncation to a span. Use Heading for titles.
components.guidance: Inherits surrounding typography. Native HTML attributes, ARIA and data attributes, and event handlers are forwarded to the rendered element; component styling is fixed. Use ordinary HTML for text that does not need truncation.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Text content.

properties.name: maxLines
properties.description: Maximum visible lines before truncation; 0 disables truncation.

components.justification: Provides line-count-based truncation on a span; no Text primitive exists in shadcn/ui or ReUI.

components.name: TimePicker
components.introduction: Native ReUI time picker with composable input, columns, and footer.
components.guidance: Use TimePickerInput or TimePickerTrigger with TimePickerContent, or TimePickerPanel for an inline picker. Native ReUI behavior snaps typed edits to available times. Use Input type="time" for a browser-native time input.

properties.name: value / defaultValue
properties.description: Canonical HH:mm or HH:mm:ss value; null is empty.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Receives a changed canonical value or null when cleared.

properties.name: hourCycle
properties.description: Displayed hour cycle.

properties.name: granularity
properties.description: Finest displayed and submitted unit.

properties.name: min / max
properties.description: Inclusive selectable bounds; min after max represents an overnight window.

properties.name: hourStep / minuteStep / secondStep
properties.description: Available steps counted from zero in each unit.

properties.name: name / form
properties.description: Native form submission name and optional external form association.

properties.name: required / disabled / readOnly
properties.description: Native validation and editing constraints.

properties.name: requireConfirm
properties.description: Retains picker selections as drafts until confirmed.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Native TimePickerTrigger, TimePickerInput, TimePickerContent, TimePickerPanel, TimePickerColumns, TimePickerColumn, TimePickerFooter, TimePickerNow, TimePickerClear, TimePickerConfirm, and TimePickerValue composition.

components.name: Timestamp
components.introduction: Formats a date or timestamp using the standard date formats.
components.guidance: Accepts native span attributes and event handlers, without children or refs. Relative timestamps expose copyable absolute-date details. Component styling is fixed in Views.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The date/time to display. Accepts Unix timestamps (seconds) or ISO 8601 strings.

properties.name: format
properties.description: Date, time, relative, or Unix-seconds display format.

components.justification: Formats timestamps and relative times with viewer-locale details and copy controls.

components.name: Token
components.introduction: Displays a tag, category, or selection with optional click and removal actions.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible text and accessible name for the token. Long labels truncate to fit.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Native ReUI Badge size.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Optional icon rendered before the label.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the token.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Accessible description of the tag or selection.

properties.name: onClick
properties.description: Runs when the token is clicked. Use Button or Link for primary actions or navigation.

properties.name: onRemove
properties.description: Shows a remove button and runs when it is clicked.

components.justification: Combines Lucide icons with selectable or removable tokens and scoped action controls.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.introduction: Native shadcn ButtonGroup composition with HTML div attributes.
components.guidance: Compose Button children with explicit size and disabled props. Use aria-label to name the group.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Connected control layout.

properties.name: aria-label
properties.description: Accessible group label.

components.name: Pagination
components.introduction: Native shadcn pagination composition with anchor attributes.
components.guidance: Compose PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, and PaginationEllipsis. Use DataPagination for page-count calculations and callbacks.

properties.name: PaginationLink.href
properties.description: Page destination URL.

properties.name: PaginationLink.isActive
properties.description: Identifies the current page.

groups.Runtime: Local state, Solution data, requests, and scoped navigation.
groups.Action: Operations and navigation through buttons, links, and action menus.
groups.Display: Records, text, metadata, status, progress, and file previews.
groups.Form: Collecting and submitting input through forms and field components.
groups.Charts: Visualizing trends, category comparisons, part-to-whole breakdowns, and directed flows.
groups.Others: Additional interface components, including geographic maps.
groups.Layouts: Arranging content, panels, navigation, dialogs, tabs, and steps.

patterns.name: Confirmation
patterns.description: Ask for Continue or Cancel before a scoped Solution operation, without managing dialog-open state.
steps: Call useConfirm() at the top level and render its element once beside the trigger Button.
Call show({ title, actionLabel, cancelLabel, onAction }) from the trigger. Description is optional; use translated labels when needed.
Await request(path, { method: 'POST', json: payload }) inside onAction. Successful actions dismiss automatically; failures stay open for retry.

patterns.name: Data table
patterns.description: Present searchable records using data-driven rows and explicit query state.
steps: Load records with the documented Hooks API and keep search/filter state local.
Define Table columns and row actions using supported props; apply filtering or pagination on the server when needed.
Use Empty with a title and optional description and actions when there are no matching records.

patterns.name: Editing form
patterns.description: Collect intent through named fields and persist changes through a validated Solution route.
steps: Inspect Form's submission contract and initialize fields from the record being edited.
Choose field components that match the server schema and use documented names and value contracts.
Submit to a Solution route that validates input and enforces authorization; display its documented success or error state.

patterns.name: Approval queue
patterns.description: Show pending work and make the next authorized action clear.
steps: Load pending records with the documented Hooks API and display their states as Table rows with Badge values.
Add explicit approve/reject actions through Button callbacks and scoped requests.
Enforce transitions and permissions on the Solution server, then refresh the queue after a successful action.
